gCanUseMask.desc: bit0=apple, 1=pester, 2=flute, 3=dash, 4=sign detector, 5=L to stop, 6=technique scoring, 7=multiple scoring, 8=multiple scoring w/o technique (used when gCanUseOverride==0)

gCanUsePerLevelMask.desc: [0]=Beach, [1]=Tunnel, [2]=Volcano, [3]=River, [4]=Cave, [5]=Valley, [6]=Rainbow. Bits within each u32 are the same as gCanUseMask. gCanUseMask takes priority.

gDialogRequestFlags.desc: Dialog flags: bit0=Cloud, 1=Apple, 2=Pester, 3=Flute, 4=6 Pokemon, 5=22 Pokemon, 6=40 Pokemon, 7=Credits

gDialogPlayedFlags.desc: Dialog flags: bit0=Cloud, 1=Apple, 2=Pester, 3=Flute, 4=6 Pokemon, 5=22 Pokemon, 6=40 Pokemon, 7=Credits

gCameraInversionYAMLOption.desc: 0=inverted, 1=normal; applied only once on entering first course

apMagic.desc: 0x53414431 'SAD1' when the AP block is valid

speciesScores.desc: [slot][0=special score, 1=special pose flags, 2=last regular pose id, 3=size, 4=technique, 5=samePkmn, 6=poseFlags, 7=totalScore]; slot=getSpeciesSlot(pokemonID, levelID)

secretExits.desc: Bit flags for secret exits taken. bit1=Tunnel,3=River,5=Valley

photosWritten.desc: number of photos on the last scored roll

photoRollCount.desc: incremented when camera check finishes scoring a roll; the client writes 0 after logging it

rawPhotoScores.desc: [roll index][0=frame (u16), 1=species slot + 1 (0 = none), 2=special pose id, 3=size, 4=pose id, 5=pose score, 6=good technique, 7=same pkmn, 8=total, 9=level id]; scored as if every scoring unlock were owned; [60] is scratch

runEventCount.desc: number of runEvents recorded this course (max 256)

auth.desc: per-seed auth token; client connects with base64(token)

savePtr.desc: pointer to the save struct (deref for base; == saveBase)

saveBase.desc: main save struct base; full layout in src/more_funcs/more_funcs.h

reportScores.desc: best PKMN Report score per species slot

registeredPhotos.desc: registered photo per species slot (stride 0x3A0); registered if s32 at +0x04 != -1
